prompt:
# Decorative prop d10179: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10179/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Jorhgamesh PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its white flame-like notched flat metal piece flat metal piece, gold crescent guard, blue hilt gem, striped grip, and compact pommel. Render one complete vertical flat metal piece with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. Do not smooth away the flat metal piece notches or replace it with a generic flat metal piece. No text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, hands, or watermark..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Jorhgamesh PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its white flame-like notched flat metal piece flat metal piece, gold crescent guard, blue hilt gem, striped grip, and compact pommel. Render one complete vertical flat metal piece with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. Do not smooth away the flat metal piece notches or replace it with a generic flat metal piece. No text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, hands, or watermark.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10179/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: first image is paint_mask_guide.png, the edit target whose exact alpha silhouettes and layout must remain unchanged. Second is design_reference.png, materials reference only. Third is icon_x8.png, colour reference only; magenta is not part of the object. Output the entire 1536x2048 sheet, not a single enlarged object. Preserve all ten small views and two empty cells.
CORRECTION: preserve the guide silhouettes strictly, including the narrow edge-on views. No stray pixels, no fuzzy fringes, no enlarged guard or blade, no silhouette distortion. The material masks must distinguish materials: blade and gold fittings pure red; blue gem and pearl endcaps pure BLACK, opaque; ivory/bone grip bands and ivory pommel core pure YELLOW; red enamel grip bands pure BLACK. No textured or shaded masks. Keep ALL outside pixels transparent. Exact 3:4 canvas. Use the guide alpha as the immutable outline. The paint views must be unlit base color, without hot specular shine.
validation_notes: Layout retained broadly, but visible edge artifacts and silhouette drift remain; raw output preserved without postprocessing.
